notes: Brainstorm list; not reviewed tasks. Scenes prefixed "new: " are proposed scene ideas not yet in data/seeds/scenes.json; concepts with concept_is_new are proposed object_* concepts. GSO models are single rigid scanned meshes: lids, hinges, zippers, laces, and deformable textiles describe the real object, so asset_compatibility for those affordances must be claimed separately (often blocked or needing part splitting). Most GSO footwear scans are a single shoe, so pair goals need a mirrored or second asset. Powered, hot, sharp, and chemical items state unplugged/cool/closed setup conditions in the goal. verified_url is true only where https://fuel.gazebosim.org/1.0/GoogleResearch/models/<name> returned HTTP 200 on the access date.
